status: Reviewed proposed conditional cancellation; not executed or activated
verdict: The proposed exact-ID conditional employee-JWT PATCH is a safe narrowing of canonical Cancel semantics. The canonical Receive row lock and post-lock pending-status check prevent a new receipt after successful cancellation. This is source/evidence reasoning, not a newly executed race or JWT/RLS test.

canonicalCancel.permission: auth.can('adjustInventory'); existing caller writeBusinessData/adjustInventory RLS also applies
canonicalCancel.proposedChange: No app/service/migration change. A one-off authorized canary cleanup request adds stricter atomic WHERE conditions to the same status-only update.

conditionalRequest.authorization: Actual approved employee JWT + existing public anon apikey; never service_role, Management SQL, forged claims or model SQL.
conditionalRequest.identifierRule: Obtain the UUID from the immutable invoice execution receipt and independently verify it belongs to this approved canary. No material-name lookup, OR filter, IN list or missing ID.

responseRequirements.success: Require an actual successful HTTP result and exactly one returned row. Verify its ID is the exact requested UUID, status=cancelled, quantity_received=0, and all three receipt/date fields remain NULL. Do not treat a 204 or empty array as confirmed success.
responseRequirements.zeroRows: No confirmed update. Read only the same exact UUID using the same current employee JWT, selecting the minimal state fields. Do not loosen any filter or infer a missing/hidden row is safe to cancel.

reconciliation.alreadyCancelledUnreceived: If the exact row is cancelled, received quantity0 and all receipt/date fields NULL, cleanup is already satisfied; record the actual state and original attempt uncertainty.
reconciliation.receivedOrPartiallyReceived: Any positive received quantity, receipt link or received_at means stop. No Receive, Undo Receive, stock correction, delete or broader Cancel is authorized.
reconciliation.pendingAllPreconditionsStillTrue: Report no confirmed cancellation and investigate authorization/result delivery. No automatic broad retry. Any bounded exact retry must retain every original predicate.
reconciliation.missingUnauthorizedOrUnexpected: Stop/report; do not use a privileged lookup or change permissions.

responseRequirements.timeoutOrError: Preserve the attempt and reconcile the same exact ID read-only before any retry. Never create a replacement receival or call Receive/Undo to clean up.

sequence: require receiveInventory for normal employee callers
SELECT pending_receivals WHERE id=p_receival_id FOR UPDATE
Check existing request_id receipt batch; an exact non-reversed replay returns without new writes
For a new receipt, reject if receival.status <> pending
Validate positive quantity and remaining expected quantity
Only then create/update on-hand and insert receipt transaction/batch
receiveSourceConfirmation.statusSemantics: The canonical partial-receipt function keeps a partially received row at literal status pending with quantity_received>0; it does not use partially_received as the accepted new-receipt status. The proposed quantity_received=0 predicate therefore protects the partial-receipt case as well.
receiveSourceConfirmation.legacyFunction: public.receive_pending_receival_with_reservation(uuid,text) locks the same row FOR UPDATE, computes remaining quantity, then delegates to receive_pending_receival_quantity with a fresh request UUID.
receiveSourceConfirmation.idempotencyCaveat: An exact previously committed receipt request may return successfully before the pending-status guard, including after a later cancellation. It is a no-op reconciliation, not a new receipt or stock increase.

concurrencyReasoning.cancelWins: The conditional UPDATE locks and commits status cancelled. A canonical Receive that subsequently obtains the same row lock sees cancelled and rejects a new receipt before stock writes. The legacy Receive wrapper delegates to that same check.
concurrencyReasoning.receiveWins: A canonical Receive holds the row lock while writing quantity/receipt fields. The conditional PATCH waits and its predicates no longer match the received/partially received row; it must not cancel it. Treat zero rows or any serialization/lock error as unconfirmed and reconcile.
concurrencyReasoning.safetyBoundary: Atomic predicates must be sent in the actual PATCH. A separate pre-read followed by the original ID-only UI Cancel does not provide this protection.

cachedHostedEvidence.observation: The recorded actual shared function definitions contain the same row lock, pending-status guard, partial-pending representation and legacy delegation. This review made no new hosted request.

afterCleanupVerification: Exact returned canary row status cancelled/quantity_received0/receipt links/date NULL
No inventory_transactions with pending_receival_id equal to this exact UUID
No pending_receival_receipt_batches with pending_receival_id equal to this exact UUID
Relevant pre-pinned caller-visible on-hand quantities remain unchanged, without attributing unrelated live activity to this canary
Original private source, immutable approval/execution/document claim and audit remain retained; do not purge them
approvals: This review does not approve the canary or cleanup execution. Product must approve the exact returned-ID cleanup as part of the final canary, and the actual employee must authorize it.
limits: No application change or new cancellation RPC is required for this narrower request.
No new concurrent PostgreSQL cancellation/Receive race, hosted PATCH or current signed-caller RLS validation was executed.
Current hosted function drift/permissions remain part of the normal final preflight; cached evidence is not a fresh query.
